cards.title: Every place's own address
cards.text: A section, a card or a page of a section, opened from its address.

cards.title: The area
cards.text: Places(home, site) reads the addresses from every page the site draws.

cards.title: The catch-all
cards.text: The router's last resort draws the page an address names.

cards.title: The page's own frame
cards.text: A place opened afresh is drawn in its page's layout.
